name: hivemind-ovos-agent-plugin
description: OVOS agent protocol plugin for hivemind-core: bridges HiveMind client messages to the OpenVoiceOS message bus
author: JarbasHiveMind

setup_notes.heading: Installation
setup_notes.content:
pip install hivemind-ovos-agent-plugin

Or install it from source:

git clone https://github.com/JarbasHiveMind/hivemind-ovos-agent-plugin
cd hivemind-ovos-agent-plugin
pip install -e .
